# Synthetic signals

The four MAT files contain four CSP trials and four IHI trials at each
of 1,000 and 4,000 Hz. Signals were generated independently at each
rate. They contain no human data.

CSP signals include a MEP transient, recovery, and two breakthrough
trials. IHI signals contain one unconditioned trial, one IHI10 trial,
two IHI40 trials, and a large pre-stimulation QC signal. The directory
name `Dose test` exercises condition labels with spaces.
